game.name: ROBLOX: Flood Escape 2
game.rules:
Your goal is to beat one level as fast as possible. The entire run must be shown from start to finish (start with a gray timer, and end with a green timer).

- Videos must be uploaded to YouTube or Twitch.

- Videos must be somewhat smooth and clear (i.e. no choppiness, no built-in Roblox recorder)

- All buttons must be pressed by YOU (or your partners in multiplayer runs). You can't pretend to press buttons after they've already been pressed.

- No exploits, macros, TAS, etc. FPS unlocker is the only allowed external program.

- No VIP admin commands. (other than set map)

- Purposefully freezing or lag-switching is not allowed.

categories.name: Solo [Glitched]
categories.rules:
All glitches are allowed.

The entire run from start (before loading into a map) to finish (when the timer turns green and the vote menu pops up) must be shown.

Timer ends when the timer text turns green, this is your final time. If you'd like to submit the 3rd millisecond digit, you can quickly reset and show your game summary in the video.

Videos longer than 10 minutes will be automatically rejected. Please make it clear and easy to find where your run is.

categories.name: Duo [Glitched]
categories.rules:
All glitches are allowed.

The entire run from start (before loading into a map) to finish (when the timer turns green and the vote menu pops up) must be shown.

Timer ends when the timer text turns green, this is your final time. In duos, the last runner to survive's time is used. If you'd like to submit the 3rd millisecond digit, you can quickly reset and show your game summary in the video.

Videos longer than 10 minutes will be automatically rejected. Please make it clear and easy to find where your run is.

categories.name: Trio [Glitched]
categories.rules:
• GLITCHES ARE ALLOWED IN THIS CATEGORY

• Timer ends when the message "You Survived!" appears on the **last player to reach the end's screen.** The IGT is your final time.

• ALL 3 players must record their POV from start to finish. This means as you spawn into the map and until the green bar appears with your time.

• Runs done on any other game besides the official Flood Escape 2 game place will not be accepted (e.g. FE2 Testing Place).

• Videos longer than 10 minutes will not be accepted. Please edit your video down to show only the level you run to the best of your ability.

Exploits to remove anti-cheat from your run are not allowed.

categories.name: Complete all of the CRAZY Maps in Flood Escape 2.
categories.rules:
NO GLITCHING

• Timer ends on the final map when the message "You Survived!" appears. Your IGT is your final time.

• Maps must be completed on the Official Flood Escape 2.

• This is to be done solo so you must be the one who presses all the buttons.

• You may reset or die as many times as you like.

• Use of exploits will result in a permeant ban from the site.

categories.name: Easy - Crazy Intensity
categories.rules:
The goal is to get to Crazy intensity as fast as possible, completing at least one map of every intensity (including one crazy map), starting from 1.00 intensity.
After completing the last map, you must reset and show your game summary and every map in it. This should take 10 maps to do.

Runs are timed by adding up all timestamps displayed on the game summary at the end.

You must complete all the maps without dying.

The intensity cannot be boosted at all.

categories.name: Techless
categories.rules:
Techless is a category where backjumps and wallhops are NOT permitted. However:

- Holding space/jump on a ladder is allowed!

- Getting off a ladder early to optimize your route is allowed!

- Using a ladder to go higher than a normal jump above it is NOT allowed!

The rules for this are a little vague right now, so don't hesitate to ask a moderator if a shortcut is allowed or not.

The entire run from start (before loading into a map) to finish (when the timer turns green and the vote menu pops up) must be shown.

Timer ends when the timer text turns green, this is your final time. If you'd like to submit the 3rd millisecond digit, you can quickly reset and show your game summary in the video.

Videos longer than 10 minutes will be automatically rejected. Please make it clear and easy to find where your run is.

categories.name: Death%
categories.rules:
Your goal is to die as fast as possible without resetting. You might do this by drowning or falling out of the map.

You cannot die to an exploding button.

Slide clips, bombs, and wallhops and backjumps are allowed.

Lag switching or freezing your game is still not allowed.

categories.name: Easy - Crazy Intensity Duos
categories.rules:
The goal is to get to Crazy intensity as fast as possible, completing at least one map of every intensity (including one crazy map), starting from 1.00 intensity.
After completing the last map, you must reset and show your game summary and every map in it. This should take 10 maps to do.

Runs are timed by adding up the times from the player who survived last on every map.

You must complete all the maps without dying.

The intensity cannot be boosted at all.

categories.name: Any%
categories.rules:
Generally all glitches are allowed here as long as they're exploit-free.

- Slide clipping IS allowed.

- Bombs and other admin powerups ARE allowed.

- Wallhops and backjumps are allowed.

- Lag switching or freezing your game IS allowed.

values.name: Current Patch
values.rules:
- Runs must be done in the main FE2 game. Community Maps and other games are not allowed.
- You cannot move before your timer starts (this often happens accidentally as a bug, it should be obvious when speedrunning)
- Your final time is the green timer text at the bottom. If you'd like to submit the 3rd millisecond digit, you can reset and show your game summary.

Other rules:

values.name: FE2 2022
values.rules:
**USE THIS GAME INSTEAD OF NORMAL FE2:** https://www.roblox.com/games/95410451364746/FE2-2022

Other rules:

- You cannot move before your timer starts (this often happens accidentally as a bug, it should be obvious when speedrunning)
- Your final time is the green timer text at the bottom. If you'd like to submit the 3rd millisecond digit, you can reset and show your game summary.

values.name: No Major Glitches
values.rules:
Backjumps, wallhops, and minor slide glides are allowed.

Slide abuse like on Ignis Peaks is not allowed. Edge cases/controversial skips will be judged individually by the mod team.

You may not corner clip or slide clip.

ALL buttons must be pressed before finishing (in duos, this only applies to the last player to finish).

If you think a skip or glitch goes against the rules or spirit of the game, feel free to reach out to a moderator to discuss.

values.name: Any%
values.rules:
Corner clips, slide clips, and basically all other tricks are allowed.

You may finish the map without pushing all the buttons (i.e. flood island buttonless route).

Intentionally freezing or lagging your game is generally discouraged, but cases will still be judged individually by the mod team.
